w3Mentions.name: The Redactor
w3Mentions.firstLine: 🌙 The cookfire's smell carried further than the laughter did — smoke and grease on the night wind. The Redactor is circling the edge of the light. It followed the feast here. (A scavenger, drawn by the feast. Face it while the feast is in you — or let the watch drive it off.)

w3Mentions.name: Gavel
w3Mentions.firstLine: The landlord is stamping the ground. Each stamp lands like a gavel. The tiles it marks start to feel wrong under your feet.

auditLine: ◈ THE AUDIT — the System reads your run back to you, and the galaxy listens. A lesser seat — global standing, waves 1–3 faced (16/13/8), 12 contests survived, 4 crises weathered. The table does not rise. It prices.
ledgerLine: The table has read your ledger. The protected outnumber the killed; the food truth was shared; promises kept. The light road is open.
finalOutcomeLines: ◈ THE ARCHITECT — Muthu Apte ascended through doors you built: relay. The galaxy will remember the god's name. The village will remember who built the door. Both are true. Neither is small.
